reports.title: Atmus Filtration Technologies Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Outlook
section: The company is raising guidance for the full year 2026 as follows:
•Total company Net sales expected to be in the range of $2,010 million to $2,035 million
◦Power Solutions segment net sales expected to be in the range of $1,850 million to $1,870 million
◦Industrial Solutions segment net sales expected to be in the range of $160 million to $165 million
•Adjusted EBITDA margin expected to be in the range of 19.75% to 20.25%
•Adjusted earnings per share expected to be in the range of $2.90 to $3.05

“I am proud of the Atmus team, whose continued dedication drove our strong financial results while ensuring our industry leading Fleetguard® and Koch Filter® branded products protect what is important to our customers,” said Steph Disher, Chief Executive Officer of Atmus. “Our strong cash generation and outlook supports the announcement of an expanded share repurchase program – we
will focus our capital allocation on investing for growth and returning cash to shareholders to create shareholder value.”
